q: Pengendalian mekanikal menggunakan peralatan berkuasa jenis berikut KECUALI:
e: Definition: use of powered equipment (hydraulic, pneumatic, electric or mechanical) to move, lift, shift, transfer loads (including human loads).

q: 'Dumbwaiter' tergolong dalam jenis peralatan pengendalian mekanikal kategori:
e: Types of equipment: lifts, dumbwaiters; escalators, travellators, walkalators; cranes and hoists; conveyors; forklifts.

q: Pengendalian mekanikal diperlukan kerana beban:
c: Berat, besar dan mempunyai pelbagai bentuk serta saiz
e: Why necessary: heavy loads, big sized load, loads of various shapes and sizes, accelerates the work process.

q: Pengendalian mekanikal menjimatkan ruang penyimpanan kerana:
c: Barang boleh disimpan secara menegak (ke atas)
e: Advantages: simplifies work, reduces time, reduces ergonomic risks, reaches awkward/high places, increases productivity, saves storage space (store upwards).

q: Batasan pengendalian mekanikal termasuk:
e: Limitations: high initial & maintenance cost, trained operators needed, limited access in tight spaces, dependent on power supply, accident risk if misused.

q: Bar perentang (spreader bar) ialah komponen:
e: Main components: lifting tackle (wire rope, sling, chain, hook, grip, eyebolts, spreader bar, shackle), lifting motor, counterweight.

q: Seksyen 24(d) OSHA mewajibkan pekerja yang terlibat dalam pengendalian mekanikal untuk:
e: Section 24(d): comply with instructions on OSH.

q: Peraturan 14 Peraturan Loji CF 2024 berkaitan dengan:
c: Pemeriksaan menyeluruh bagi jentera angkat tertentu
e: Part VI: Reg. 13 use of lift/escalator/walkalator; Reg. 14 comprehensive examination; Reg. 15 operation of tower crane and mobile crane; Reg. 16 lifting tackle.

q: Meletakkan komponen berat dengan tepat seperti pemasangan jentera dan rasuk ialah aktiviti:
e: Activities: 1 lifting & lowering; 2 moving & transporting; 3 positioning & placing (machinery installation, stacking pallets, beams).

q: Pemindahan barang dari lori, kontena atau stor menggunakan forklift atau kren ialah aktiviti:
e: 4. Loading & unloading: transferring goods from trucks, containers or storage areas – warehouses, ports, construction sites.

q: Penggunaan tong, troli berkuasa dan peralatan angkat untuk memindahkan sisa industri termasuk dalam aktiviti:
e: 8. Waste & scrap handling: bins, powered trolleys, lifting equipment to collect and transfer industrial waste or scrap safely.

q: Bahaya utama forklift termasuk:
e: Forklifts: collision with workers/objects, overturning, falling loads, operator fatigue.

q: Bahaya kabel putus, beban lampau dan belitan paling berkait dengan:
e: Hoists & winches: cable snapping, overloading, entanglement, falling loads.

q: Bahaya 'pinch points' dan pendedahan habuk paling berkait dengan:
e: Conveyors: entanglement in rollers/belts, pinch points, falling materials, dust exposure.

q: Keruntuhan mengejut akibat kegagalan hidraulik ialah bahaya bagi:
e: Lifts, dumbwaiters: sudden collapse from hydraulic failure, overloading, slipping loads.

q: Kemalangan seperti AGV melanggar pekerja dan beban troli palet jatuh berlaku semasa aktiviti:
e: Moving & transporting loads: forklift collision with pedestrians, pallet truck load falling, AGV striking worker.

q: Lif jatuh bebas akibat kegagalan brek ialah contoh kemalangan dalam aktiviti:
e: Human load handling: elevator sudden stop trapping passengers, escalator entrapment, elevator free fall due to brake failure.

q: Langkah kawalan 'Keselamatan Beban' (Load Security) menekankan:
c: Mengikat beban dengan kaedah betul dan memastikan kestabilan sebelum bergerak
e: Control 5 Load Security: secure loads (slings, clamps, pallets) and confirm stability before movement; 6 Safety devices functional.

q: Langkah kawalan 'Kesiapsiagaan Kecemasan' termasuk:
c: Menyediakan peranti henti kecemasan yang mudah dicapai dan melatih pekerja
w: Membenarkan pejalan kaki dekat zon operasi
e: Control 9 Emergency Preparedness: accessible emergency stop devices and train workers in response procedures.

q: Dalam kemalangan Shah Alam, mangsa sedang melakukan apa ketika blok pemberat jatuh?
c: Memberi arahan kepada operator kren untuk mengangkat blok cangkuk
e: Shah Alam (April 2025): foreign worker crushed by counterweight block from tower crane hook assembly while giving instructions to the operator to lift the hook block.
